hero.sub: Real-time posture monitoring that runs entirely on your machine. No camera stream ever leaves your computer. No account, no cloud, no compromise.

features.subtitle: Six deliberate choices — privacy, accuracy, calm. The rest of the industry can keep its dark patterns.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.description: Camera frames never leave your computer. There is no cloud component to bypass — because there is no cloud.

realtime.title: Real-time detection
realtime.description: MediaPipe Pose runs locally at 25–30 FPS, tracking CVA, shoulder symmetry and spinal alignment frame by frame.

personalized.title: Personalized baseline
personalized.description: A 5-second calibration captures your individual normal posture, so alerts compare against you — not a generic textbook.

clinical.title: Clinical accuracy
clinical.description: Research-backed thresholds (Kim 2024b, Cortes 2024, Moreira 2022) catch breaches even if your baseline calibration was off.

multiLanguage.title: Multi-language
multiLanguage.description: Use PosturePal in English or Türkçe. The UI adapts entirely; nothing is left untranslated.

freeOpen.title: Free & open
freeOpen.description: Free to download. Source on GitHub. Audit the privacy promise yourself, line by line.

howItWorks.title: Three steps. Five seconds. Done.
howItWorks.subtitle: From install to actionable feedback in under a minute.

download.title: Download
download.description: Grab the installer for macOS. No account, no email — just download and open.

calibrate.title: Calibrate
calibrate.description: Sit naturally for 5 seconds. PosturePal records your normal posture as a personal baseline.

monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.description: Get gentle, intelligent alerts when you slip. The clinical safety layer protects against bad calibrations.

privacy.title: Your camera never leaves your computer
privacy.subtitle: We don't have a server. There's nothing for us to leak, sell, or hand over to anyone.

noCloud.title: No cloud
noCloud.description: Pose detection runs in WebAssembly inside the app. No frames or pose data are sent to a server — there isn't one.

noTracking.title: No tracking
noTracking.description: No analytics, no telemetry, no third-party scripts. Not on this site. Not in the app.

noAccount.title: No account
noAccount.description: We don't ask for an email, a name, or anything else. Install and use.

openSource.title: Inspectable
openSource.description: The source code is on GitHub. Read it. Diff it. Build it yourself if you want.

requirements.title: System requirements
requirements.subtitle: Modest. PosturePal runs on the laptop you already have.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.lede: PosturePal is built around a single rule: nothing about you leaves your computer. This page explains exactly what that means.

dataCollection.title: What data we collect
dataCollection.body: Nothing. PosturePal has no server, no backend, no third party that receives your data.
dataCollection.point1: Camera frames are processed in WebAssembly inside the app and immediately discarded.
dataCollection.point2: Posture metrics (CVA, shoulder asymmetry, alignment angle) are stored locally in SQLite on your computer.
dataCollection.point3: We have no analytics, no error reporting, no telemetry — anywhere.

camera.body: Camera: required, used only for live pose detection. The app never records, saves, or transmits camera frames.

notifications.body: Notifications: optional, used to remind you when your posture slips. You can disable this in Settings at any time.

localStorage.title: Local storage
localStorage.body: Settings, your calibration baseline, posture sessions, and 30-second posture snapshots are stored in a SQLite database under your operating system's standard application-data directory. You can delete this file at any time to wipe everything PosturePal knows about you.

noTelemetry.title: No telemetry. Ever.
noTelemetry.body: Many apps quietly send 'usage statistics' or 'crash reports'. PosturePal does not. There is no out-of-band network traffic from the app.

openSource.title: You don't have to take our word for it
openSource.body: PosturePal is open source. The full code, including the network and IPC handlers, is auditable on GitHub:
